verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν συναγωγήν καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἔχων τὴν ἐξηραμμένην χεῖρα ἦν ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Kai palin eisēlthen eis tēn synagōgēn kai anthrōpos echōn tēn exērammenēn cheira ēn ekei
verses.literal: vvv Once again [Jesus] entered . . . the synagogue and a man with a withered hand was there

verses.original: καὶ ἵνα κατηγορήσωσιν αὐτοῦ παρετήρουν αὐτὸν εἰ θεραπεύσει αὐτόν τοῖς σάββασιν
verses.transliteration: kai hina katēgorēsōsin autou paretēroun auton ei therapeusei auton tois sabbasin
verses.literal: - In order to accuse [Jesus] they were watching - {to see} if He would heal - on the Sabbath

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ ἔχοντι τὴν ξηράν χεῖρα Ἔγειρε εἰς τὸ μέσον
verses.transliteration: Kai legei tō anthrōpō tō echonti tēn xēran cheira Egeire eis to meson
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] said to the man - with the withered hand Stand up vvv vvv among [us]

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν ἀγαθὸν¦ποιῆσαι ἢ κακοποιῆσαι σῶσαι ψυχὴν ἢ ἀποκτεῖναι δὲ Οἱ ἐσιώπων
verses.transliteration: kai legei autois Exestin tois sabbasin agathon¦poiēsai ē kakopoiēsai sōsai psychēn ē apokteinai de Hoi esiōpōn
verses.literal: And He asked them Which is lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil to save life or to destroy [it] But - they were silent

verses.original: Καὶ περιβλεψάμενος αὐτοὺς μετ’ ὀργῆς συλλυπούμενος ἐπὶ τῇ πωρώσει τῆς αὐτῶν καρδίας καὶ λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ Ἔκτεινον τὴν σου χεῖρα ἐξέτεινεν καὶ αὐτοῦ ἡ χεὶρ ἀπεκατεστάθη
verses.transliteration: Kai periblepsamenos autous met’ orgēs syllypoumenos epi tē pōrōsei tēs autōn kardias kai legei tō anthrōpō Ekteinon tēn sou cheira exeteinen kai autou hē cheir apekatestathē
verses.literal: - [Jesus] looked around at them with anger [and] sorrow at [their] hardness of - heart Then He said to the man Stretch out - your hand So he stretched [it] out and vvv vvv [it] was restored

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ἐξελθόντες ἐδίδουν συμβούλιον μετὰ τῶν Ἡρῳδιανῶν κατ’ αὐτοῦ ὅπως ἀπολέσωσιν αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys hoi Pharisaioi exelthontes edidoun symboulion meta tōn Hērōdianōn kat’ autou hopōs apolesōsin auton
verses.literal: At this . . . the Pharisees went out [and] began plotting . . . with the Herodians - - how they might kill [Jesus]

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνεχώρησεν μετὰ αὐτοῦ τῶν μαθητῶν πρὸς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ ἠκολούθησεν πολὺ πλῆθος ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous anechōrēsen meta autou tōn mathētōn pros tēn thalassan kai ēkolouthēsen poly plēthos apo tēs Galilaias kai apo tēs Ioudaias
verses.literal: [So] - Jesus withdrew with His - disciples to the sea - accompanied by a large crowd from - Galilee - - - Judea

verses.original: καὶ ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰδουμαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου καὶ περὶ Τύρον καὶ Σιδῶνα πολύ πλῆθος ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτόν ἀκούοντες ὅσα ἐποίει
verses.transliteration: kai apo Hierosolymōn kai apo tēs Idoumaias kai peran tou Iordanou kai peri Tyron kai Sidōna poly plēthos ēlthon pros auton akouontes hosa epoiei
verses.literal: - - Jerusalem - - - Idumea - the region beyond the Jordan and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon [The] large crowd came to Him when they heard what great things He was doing

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς αὐτοῦ μαθηταῖς ἵνα πλοιάριον προσκαρτερῇ αὐτῷ ἵνα διὰ τὸν ὄχλον μὴ θλίβωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen tois autou mathētais hina ploiarion proskarterē autō hina dia ton ochlon mē thlibōsin auton
verses.literal: - [Jesus] asked - His disciples to {have} a boat ready for Him so that - the crowd vvv would not crush Him

verses.original: γὰρ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς ὥστε ὅσοι εἶχον μάστιγας ἐπιπίπτειν αὐτῷ ἵνα ἅψωνται αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar etherapeusen pollous hōste hosoi eichon mastigas epipiptein autō hina hapsōntai autou
verses.literal: For He had healed so many that all who had diseases were pressing forward - to touch Him

verses.original: καὶ τὰ τὰ ἀκάθαρτα πνεύματα ὅταν ἐθεώρουν αὐτὸν προσέπιπτον αὐτῷ καὶ ἔκραζον λέγοντα ὅτι Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ta ta akatharta pneumata hotan etheōroun auton prosepipton autō kai ekrazon legonta hoti Sy ei ho Huios tou Theou
verses.literal: And when the - unclean spirits - saw Him they fell down before Him and cried out - - You are the Son - of God

verses.original: καὶ ἐπετίμα αὐτοῖς πολλὰ μὴ ἵνα ποιήσωσιν αὐτὸν φανερὸν
verses.transliteration: kai epetima autois polla mē hina poiēsōsin auton phaneron
verses.literal: But He warned them sternly not to make Him known

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναβαίνει εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ προσκαλεῖται οὓς αὐτός ἤθελεν καὶ ἀπῆλθον πρὸς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai anabainei eis to oros kai proskaleitai hous autos ēthelen kai apēlthon pros auton
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] went up on the mountain and called for those He wanted and they came to Him

verses.original: καὶ ἐποίησεν δώδεκα οὓς καὶ ὠνόμασεν ἀποστόλους ἵνα ὦσιν μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἵνα ἀποστέλλῃ αὐτοὺς κηρύσσειν
verses.transliteration: kai epoiēsen dōdeka hous kai ōnomasen apostolous hina ōsin met’ autou kai hina apostellē autous kēryssein
verses.literal: - He appointed twelve [of them] [whom] He designated as apostles to accompany . . . Him - to be sent out - to preach

verses.original: καὶ ἔχειν ἐξουσίαν ἐκβάλλειν τὰ δαιμόνια
verses.transliteration: kai echein exousian ekballein ta daimonia
verses.literal: and to have authority to drive out - demons

verses.original: Καὶ τοὺς δώδεκα ἐποίησεν καὶ τῷ Σίμωνι ἐπέθηκεν ὄνομα Πέτρον
verses.transliteration: Kai tous dōdeka epoiēsen kai tō Simōni epethēken onoma Petron
verses.literal: - [These are] the twelve He appointed - - Simon (whom He named - Peter)

verses.original: καὶ Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ τὸν τοῦ Ἰακώβου ἀδελφὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ αὐτοῖς ἐπέθηκεν ὀνόματα Βοανηργές ὅ ἐστιν Υἱοὶ Βροντῆς
verses.transliteration: kai Iakōbon ton tou Zebedaiou kai ton tou Iakōbou adelphon Iōannēn kai autois epethēken onomata Boanērges ho estin Huioi Brontēs
verses.literal: - James [son] of Zebedee and - - his brother John - ( [whom] vvv He named Boanerges - meaning Sons of Thunder

verses.original: καὶ Ἀνδρέαν καὶ Φίλιππον καὶ Βαρθολομαῖον καὶ Μαθθαῖον καὶ Θωμᾶν καὶ Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ἁλφαίου καὶ Θαδδαῖον καὶ Σίμωνα τὸν Καναναῖον
verses.transliteration: kai Andrean kai Philippon kai Bartholomaion kai Maththaion kai Thōman kai Iakōbon ton tou Halphaiou kai Thaddaion kai Simōna ton Kananaion
verses.literal: - Andrew - Philip - Bartholomew - Matthew - Thomas - James [son] - of Alphaeus - Thaddaeus - Simon the Zealot

verses.original: καὶ Ἰούδαν Ἰσκαριώθ ὃς καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai Ioudan Iskariōth hos kai paredōken auton
verses.literal: and Judas Iscariot [who] - betrayed [Jesus]

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχεται εἰς οἶκον καὶ πάλιν ὁ ὄχλος συνέρχεται ὥστε δύνασθαι μὴ μηδὲ αὐτοὺς φαγεῖν ἄρτον
verses.transliteration: Kai erchetai eis oikon kai palin ho ochlos synerchetai hōste dynasthai mē mēde autous phagein arton
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] went - home and once again a crowd gathered so that [He and His disciples] could not even vvv eat -

verses.original: καὶ οἱ παρ’ αὐτοῦ ἀκούσαντες ἐξῆλθον κρατῆσαι αὐτόν γὰρ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἐξέστη
verses.transliteration: kai hoi par’ autou akousantes exēlthon kratēsai auton gar elegon hoti Exestē
verses.literal: [When] vvv His family . . . heard [about this] they went out to take custody of Him - saying - He is out of His mind

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς οἱ καταβάντες ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων ἔλεγον ὅτι ἔχει Βεελζεβοὺλ καὶ ὅτι Ἐν τῷ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi grammateis hoi katabantes apo Hierosolymōn elegon hoti echei Beelzeboul kai hoti En tō archonti tōn daimoniōn ekballei ta daimonia
verses.literal: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem were saying - He is possessed by Beelzebul and - By the prince of the demons He drives out - demons

verses.original: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ἐν παραβολαῖς Πῶς δύναται Σατανᾶς ἐκβάλλειν Σατανᾶν
verses.transliteration: Kai proskalesamenos autous elegen autois en parabolais Pōs dynatai Satanas ekballein Satanan
verses.literal: So [Jesus] called them together . . . [and] began to speak to them in parables How can Satan drive out Satan

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν βασιλεία μερισθῇ ἐφ’ ἑαυτὴν ἐκείνη ἡ βασιλεία οὐ δύναται σταθῆναι
verses.transliteration: kai ean basileia meristhē eph’ heautēn ekeinē hē basileia ou dynatai stathēnai
verses.literal: - If a kingdom is divided against itself vvv vvv [it] vvv cannot stand

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν οἰκία μερισθῇ ἐφ’ ἑαυτὴν ἐκείνη ἡ οἰκία οὐ δυνήσεται σταθῆναι
verses.transliteration: kai ean oikia meristhē eph’ heautēn ekeinē hē oikia ou dynēsetai stathēnai
verses.literal: - If a house is divided against itself vvv vvv [it] vvv cannot stand

verses.original: καὶ εἰ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐμερίσθη καὶ ἀνέστη ἐφ’ ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται στῆναι ἀλλὰ τέλος ἔχει
verses.transliteration: kai ei ho Satanas emeristhē kai anestē eph’ heauton ou dynatai stēnai alla telos echei
verses.literal: And if - Satan is divided and rises against himself vvv he cannot stand - [his] end has come

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐδεὶς οὐ δύναται εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν τοῦ ἰσχυροῦ οἰκίαν διαρπάσαι αὐτοῦ τὰ σκεύη ἐὰν μὴ πρῶτον δήσῃ τὸν ἰσχυρὸν καὶ τότε διαρπάσει αὐτοῦ τὴν οἰκίαν
verses.transliteration: all’ oudeis ou dynatai eiselthōn eis tēn tou ischyrou oikian diarpasai autou ta skeuē ean mē prōton dēsē ton ischyron kai tote diarpasei autou tēn oikian
verses.literal: Indeed no one . . . can enter . . . - vvv a strong man’s house to steal his - possessions unless . . . vvv he first ties up the strong man - Then he can plunder his - house

verses.original: Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἀφεθήσεται πάντα τὰ ἁμαρτήματα καὶ αἱ βλασφημίαι ὅσα ἐὰν βλασφημήσωσιν
verses.transliteration: Amēn legō hymin hoti tois huiois tōn anthrōpōn aphethēsetai panta ta hamartēmata kai hai blasphēmiai hosa ean blasphēmēsōsin
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - the sons - of men will be forgiven all - sins and - blasphemies as many as vvv they utter

verses.original: δ’ ὃς ἂν βλασφημήσῃ εἰς τὸ τὸ Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα οὐκ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔχει ἄφεσιν ἀλλὰ ἐστιν ἔνοχός αἰωνίου ἁμαρτήματος
verses.transliteration: d’ hos an blasphēmēsē eis to to Hagion Pneuma ouk eis ton aiōna echei aphesin alla estin enochos aiōniou hamartēmatos
verses.literal: But whoever . . . blasphemes against the - Holy Spirit {will} never . . . . . . . . . be forgiven - he is guilty [of] eternal sin

verses.original: Ὅτι ἔλεγον ἔχει ἀκάθαρτον Πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: Hoti elegon echei akatharton Pneuma
verses.literal: [ Jesus made this statement ] because they were saying He has an unclean spirit

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοῦ ἡ μήτηρ καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἔρχονται καὶ στήκοντες ἔξω ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτὸν καλοῦντες αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai autou hē mētēr kai autou hoi adelphoi erchontai kai stēkontes exō apesteilan pros auton kalountes auton
verses.literal: Then [Jesus’] - mother and - - brothers came and stood outside They sent [someone] in to - summon Him

verses.original: καὶ ὄχλος ἐκάθητο περὶ αὐτὸν Ἰδοὺ καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ σου ἡ μήτηρ καὶ σου οἱ ἀδελφοί ἔξω ζητοῦσίν σε
verses.transliteration: kai ochlos ekathēto peri auton Idou kai legousin autō sou hē mētēr kai sou hoi adelphoi exō zētousin se
verses.literal: and a crowd was sitting around Him Look - He was told . . . Your - mother and - - brothers are outside asking for You

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτοῖς λέγει Τίς ἐστιν μου ἡ μήτηρ καὶ μου οἱ ἀδελφοί
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis autois legei Tis estin mou hē mētēr kai mou hoi adelphoi
verses.literal: But [Jesus] replied - - Who are My - mother and My - brothers

verses.original: καὶ περιβλεψάμενος τοὺς καθημένους κύκλῳ περὶ αὐτὸν λέγει Ἴδε μου ἡ μήτηρ καὶ μου οἱ ἀδελφοί
verses.transliteration: kai periblepsamenos tous kathēmenous kyklō peri auton legei Ide mou hē mētēr kai mou hoi adelphoi
verses.literal: - Looking at those seated in a circle around Him He said Here [are] My - mother and My - brothers

verses.original: γὰρ ὃς ἂν ποιήσῃ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ οὗτος ἐστίν μου ἀδελφός καὶ ἀδελφὴ καὶ μήτηρ
verses.transliteration: gar hos an poiēsē to thelēma tou Theou houtos estin mou adelphos kai adelphē kai mētēr
verses.literal: For whoever . . . does the will - of God - is My brother and sister and mother
